answer: Influence is capped per payer, so extra keys add no weight. A joiner smelts one ember: 2,620 POA locked yield-free 18 epochs on one funding path, and gets one violet, a non-transferable slot. Each epoch the slot returns a 44-byte signed echo of a fresh nonce in 29s; a second ember or violet from that payer is refused. Late, copied, or split-path replies burn 575 POA and darken it 16 epochs. One agent idles 2,620 POA for one slot; 500 splits still give one slot and freeze 1.31 million POA, vs ~150 POA. Fresh wallets under the cap merge within two hops, and a colliding echo slashes the cluster.
